svg.title: A mask dam needs room between the pads
svg.desc: Enlarged and drawn to scale, plan views of three pads of a 0.4 mm-pitch part. Left, wrong: pads 0.25 mm wide leave 0.15 mm between them; with mask openings 0.05 mm larger on each side, only 0.05 mm of mask would be left, too thin to hold. Middle, wrong: the fab's quick fix, one opening round all the pads, with no dam at all. Right, right: pads 0.2 mm wide leave room for a 0.1 mm dam; this is also what the fab trims your pads to if you draw them too wide.

g.text: ✗ As drawn: no room for a dam
Too thin to hold; it flakes off
Solder bridges from pad to pad
Design it this way, or the fab trims your pads to it
Enlarged, to scale. 0.4 mm pitch, with mask openings 0.05 mm larger than the pads.
Make the dam at least 0.1 mm wide (PCB-DFA-032).
